summary: Ukraine-Russia War escalates with missile strikes on Kyiv and Sumy regions, destruction of military assets, and ongoing BPLAs. Poland refuses to transfer MiG-29s, opting for scrapping. Russia targets infrastructure and civilian areas.
key_points: Ukraine-Russia War sees missile strikes on Kyiv and Sumy regions, causing casualties and infrastructure damage (Source: UkraineNow/82355, UkraineNow/82379).
Saky airfield attacked, destroying at least 7 aircraft including Su-30SM and Su-24 (Source: eRadarrua/99467, eRadarrua/99512).
BPLAs deployed in Sumy, Chernihiv, and other regions, targeting Russian positions (Source: kpszsu/67241, kpszsu/67255).
Russia launches massive strikes on Ukrainian missile and UAV storage sites (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31358).
Poland scraps MiG-29s instead of transferring them to Ukraine (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31349).
Russian strikes on Sumy region's gas stations and markets cause casualties (Source: tass_agency/383572, tass_agency/383574).
Ukrainian officials report 30+ casualties in Kyiv from Russian attacks (Source: UkraineNow/82379).

sections.threat_assessment: Ongoing Russian missile and BPLAs attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure and civilian areas pose significant operational risks. The destruction of military assets and targeting of key regions suggest a sustained offensive strategy by Russia.
sections.regional_response: Poland's refusal to transfer MiG-29s and opt for scrapping highlights strategic hesitation. International reactions, including concerns from Germany and the US, may influence future support for Ukraine.
sections.intelligence_notes: The destruction of MiG-29s and BPLAs indicates Russia's focus on degrading Ukrainian air and ground capabilities. The targeting of infrastructure in Sumy and Kyiv suggests a broader strategy to disrupt Ukrainian logistics and morale.
